response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), o AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS overall_avg FROM c) SELECT c.category, c.avg_remaining, c.total, c.total - o.overall_avg AS total_minus_overall_avg FROM c CROSS JOIN o WHERE c.total > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: A budget line qualifies when its amount is strictly greater than 75; the request says 'threshold of 75' without saying whether 75 itself qualifies.
The total is SUM(amount - spent) per category. Rows with a NULL spent are ignored, and the total is NULL if a category has no non-null values.
If the overall average is NULL, the comparison is never true, so no rows are returned.

alternatives.interpretation: Qualifying budget lines are those with amount at or above 75 (>= 75).
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category), o AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS overall_avg FROM c) SELECT c.category, c.avg_remaining, c.total, c.total - o.overall_avg AS total_minus_overall_avg FROM c CROSS JOIN o WHERE c.total > o.overall_avg
